newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan May 1st 20 days trade surplus 41.16 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: Japan May 1st 20 days trade surplus 41.16 bln yen.

text.p: Japan posted a customs-cleared trade surplus of 41.16 billion yen in the first 20 days of May, compared with a deficit of 180.94 billion yen in the same period a year earlier, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Thursday.
Free-on-board (FOB) exports in the period rose 25.8 percent from a year earlier to 2.27 trillion yen, while cost, insurance and freight (CIF) imports increased 12.2 percent to 2.22 trillion yen.
